summaryZh: 港中大—UC San Diego 中国经济联合实验室汇集学者研究中国经济的关键问题。明确方向包括科技、经济史与发展、政商关系、法律制度以及气候变化与经济；页面未说明具体实证方法。

evidence.quote: This lab serves as a nexus for cutting-edge interdisciplinary research, bringing together scholars and students to explore critical issues shaping China's economic landscape. Key areas of research include: Science and Technology Economic History and Development Government and Business Dynamics Legal Institutions Climate Change and the Economy
CUHK-UC San Diego Joint Laboratory on Chinese Economy
collaboration between the Department of Economics at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and the 21st Century China Center at the UC San Diego School of Global Policy and Strategy.
